claude.name: Claude Code
claude.note: Claude Code CLI. stream-json mode requires --verbose.

cursor.name: Cursor Agent
cursor.note: Verified 2026-06-01 with cursor-agent v2.x. No --session-id, --max-turns, or --skip-permissions flags. Uses --resume <chatId> / --continue for session persistence.

codex.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
codex.note: OpenAI Codex CLI. Uses 'codex exec' for non-interactive mode. Output format is JSON with '--json' flag.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.note: OpenCode CLI. Uses 'opencode run' for non-interactive mode. Output format may vary — check your version.

deveco.name: DevEco Studio AI
deveco.note: Verified 2026-06-01 with deveco CLI. Uses 'deveco run --format json <prompt>' for non-interactive. No --max-turns flag. --session only works for resume (existing sessions), not for creating new ones. Has --dangerously-skip-permissions.

generic.name: Generic Agent (JSON)
generic.note: Generic fallback. Replace 'binary' and flags with your agent's actual CLI. The generic_json parser auto-detects event structure.

text.name: Text-Only Agent
text.note: Fallback for agents that only produce plain text. Parses file paths from text lines heuristically.
